package enumfixture_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"path/filepath"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"enumfixture/dao"
	"enumfixture/dto"
	"enumfixture/mapper"
	"enumfixture/model"
	"gorm.io/driver/sqlite"
	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

func TestEnums(t *testing.T) { // 类型、翻译、并发只读和序列化保持数据库原值。
	if model.GetOrderStatusEnumLabel(model.OrderStatusEnumPending) != "待支付" || model.OrderStatusEnumPaid.Label() != "已支付" {
		t.Fatal("status translation")
	}
	if model.GetOrderStageEnumLabel(model.OrderStageEnumValue1) != "待支付" {
		t.Fatal("numeric string translation")
	}
	if model.OrderStatusEnum("future").Label() != "future" || model.OrderStatusEnum("future").Valid() || !model.OrderStatusEnumPaid.Valid() {
		t.Fatal("unknown value handling")
	}
	if model.TestStatusEnumPending.Label() != "pending" || model.GetTestStageEnumLabel(model.TestStageEnumValue3) != "已取消" {
		t.Fatal("table naming")
	}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for range 32 {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			for range 1000 {
				if model.OrderStatusEnumPaid.Label() != "已支付" {
					t.Error("concurrent label")
				}
			}
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	data, err := json.Marshal(model.OrderStatusEnumPaid)
	if err != nil || string(data) != `"paid"` {
		t.Fatalf("%s %v", data, err)
	}
	data, err = json.Marshal(model.OrderStageEnumValue1)
	if err != nil || string(data) != `"1"` {
		t.Fatalf("numeric ENUM changed: %s %v", data, err)
	}
}

func TestEnumDatabaseMapperAndDAO(t *testing.T) { // 实际生成 Model 支持写入、查询、更新及 DTO/VO 的显式转换。
	db, err := gorm.Open(sqlite.Open(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "roundtrip.db")))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pool, _ := db.DB()
	t.Cleanup(func() { pool.Close() })
	if err := db.Exec(`CREATE TABLE "order" (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending','paid','cancelled')), stage TEXT)`).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	m := mapper.NewOrderMapper()
	entity := m.DtoToEntity(&dto.CreateOrderDTO{Status: "pending", Stage: "1"})
	entity.ID = 1
	if entity.Status != model.OrderStatusEnumPending || entity.Stage != model.OrderStageEnumValue1 {
		t.Fatal(entity)
	}
	q := dao.Use(db)
	if err := q.OrderEntity.Create(entity); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	loaded, err := q.OrderEntity.WithContext(context.Background()).Where(q.OrderEntity.Status.Eq(string(model.OrderStatusEnumPending))).First()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if loaded.Status != model.OrderStatusEnumPending || m.EntityToVO(loaded).Status != "pending" {
		t.Fatal(loaded)
	}
	if _, err := q.OrderEntity.Where(q.OrderEntity.ID.Eq(1)).UpdateSimple(q.OrderEntity.Status.Value(string(model.OrderStatusEnumPaid))); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	loaded, err = q.OrderEntity.Where(q.OrderEntity.ID.Eq(1)).First()
	if err != nil || loaded.Status != model.OrderStatusEnumPaid {
		t.Fatalf("%+v %v", loaded, err)
	}
	if err := db.Model(&model.OrderEntity{}).Where("id = ?", 1).Update("status", model.OrderStatusEnumCancelled).Error; err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := db.Model(&model.OrderEntity{}).Where("id = ?", 1).Update("status", model.OrderStatusEnum("invalid")).Error; err == nil {
		t.Fatal("database accepted invalid enum")
	}
	if got := fmt.Sprint(model.OrderStatusEnumCancelled); got != "cancelled" {
		t.Fatal(got)
	}
}
